scope: Actual formatter and complete body-field descriptor resolution; not hosted gRPC/HTTP throughput or full startup.
final: Per-call char span: stack for input.Length <= 128, heap array otherwise, one final string

requirement_coverage.requirement: Exact empty, separator, acronym, case-transition, digits, period flags, trailing marker and Unicode/surrogate behavior; every row exercises all four flag combinations
Letter output, zero-output separators and trailing marker replacement immediately before/at/after bounded buffer threshold, including empty, single and large fallback
Real generated protobuf field/repetition/CLR property selection and actual distinct value identity for sub, sub_data, repeated_strings, repeated_messages and map_strings
Real compiled formatter and complete actual descriptor producer, property/value identity, star/missing/echo controls

measurement_verdict.variance_cause: Unverified; complete raw statistics retained, no harmless-noise/JIT explanation.

excluded_or_unverified: Full application startup, hosted gRPC/HTTP and production throughput
Cold runtime, concurrency, stack/heap pressure and other architectures/runtimes
Heap regression for large separator-only inputs: heap array is allocated despite empty output
Production input distribution and cause of measurement/control variance
Native IIS, ReadyToRun and installer packaging; disabled for source-built managed test prerequisites
